decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch is close to the core seasonal range, was featured on the home page in both years, and costs little to keep in a catalog where such items typically stay for years.
The one-tier pyramid is a core folk-art product that fits existing workshop skills, so keeping it is cheap and its seasonal value is fairly well established.
The electronic music box is distant from the core and its value is still uncertain, but the firm kept investing in new discs and editions, which suggests the option is still worth holding.
A second edition with its own page in 2019 signals further commitment, though as a distant, possibly licensed platform it carries real risk of being phased out.
The Christmas-themed music box motif fits the firm's seasonal sales peak, which makes it a low-cost extension of the music box option worth keeping while its demand becomes clearer.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on established craftsmanship, was prominently featured, and is the kind of collectible piece that typically remains in the range.
